function.name: get_website_geo_mapping_rules
function.description: Retrieve the geographic mapping rules configured for a specific website by its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the geo mapping rules are to be retrieved. The identifier should be in UUID format.

function.name: set_website_geo_mapping_rules
function.description: This function sets custom geographic mapping rules for a specific website by using its unique website identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

websiteId.description: The unique identifier of the website for which the geo mapping rules are to be set. This is typically a UUID.

geoMappingRules.description: A list of custom geographic mapping rules defined as strings. Each rule should specify a geographic region and the corresponding action.

function.name: get_mobile_app_geo_mapping_rules
function.description: Retrieves the custom geographical mapping rules configured for a specific mobile application. These rules can be used to tailor app behavior based on the geographical location of the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mobileAppId.description: The unique identifier of the mobile application for which the geo mapping rules are to be fetched.
